title: Magnet hsh
description: Adds Magnet & Ore Magnet. Pulls items from 10 blocks. 3000 durability, repairable with copper
body: Magnet Mod adds two magnetic items to Minecraft 1.20.1. The Magnet attracts all dropped items within a 10-block radius. The Ore Magnet attracts only ore materials (coal, iron, copper, gold, lapis, redstone, diamond, quartz, netherite). Both have 3000 durability, are repairable with copper ingots on an anvil, and appear in the Tools & Utilities creative tab.
